Class GameView

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.GameView
public class GameView extends Object
Board-first arcade view: one HUD row and a compact start/pause/game-over panel.

    • bodyPath

      static List<javafx.geometry.Point2D> bodyPath(List<Point> body, Point head, List<Point> oldBody, Point oldHead, int width, int height, double fraction)
      Builds an interpolated tail-to-head path while keeping occupied bends fixed.
      Parameters:
      body - current body positions ordered tail first
      head - current head cell
      oldBody - previous body positions ordered tail first
      oldHead - previous head cell
      width - board width in cells
      height - board height in cells
      fraction - movement progress from 0 to 1
      Returns:
      new path in cell coordinates ending at the interpolated head

    • interpolate

      static double interpolate(int from, int to, int size, double progress)
      Interpolates a one-cell coordinate change, taking the short route across a wrapped boundary.
      Parameters:
      from - previous cell coordinate
      to - current cell coordinate
      size - board dimension on this axis
      progress - movement progress; values at least 1 return the destination
      Returns:
      interpolated coordinate, which may briefly lie outside the board at a wrap
